attestations.text: KU Tsu-yü 顧祖禹 (T. 景范, H. 宛溪), 1631–1692, geographer, was a native of Wu-hsi, Kiangsu. Because he spent much of his life in Ch'ang-shu (a district in the same province) he occasionally designated himself a native of that place.
